request: File a ticket to show a CSV download control on search results with a clear, readable label. Keep the change limited to that control.

drafts.title: Show a CSV download control
drafts.body:
## Description
Show a CSV download control on search results and guarantee that every user is always happy with the export.

## Open questions
- Unresolved: What observable outcome defines happy for every user?
drafts.estimateBasis: A human developer would spend one hour adding the control and two hours testing and verifying; this excludes the undefined happiness guarantee.
